messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: High error rate detected in dedicated pool elm-pool (region: us-west-2) affecting tenant AureliaCorp (VPC: vc-aur-01). Error rate > 10% for 5m. Alert ID: alert-2164507890

mira (oncall): paging in. pulling metrics & recent deploys

alex (eng-runtime): looking at qps/latency and serving logs. no active deploys in last 24h. seeing OOMs and repeated connection resets on 3/12 pods in elm-pool

jen (sre): can we isolate tenant traffic? suggest setting per-tenant rate-limit and divert to fallback model variant to buy time

mira (oncall): initiating mitigation: applying rate limit 30r/s to tenant AureliaCorp, diverting to model-variant v1.11-fallback, notifying customer-eng

alex (eng-runtime): running patch to pool config now. command:
```
kubectl -n elm patch configmap pool-elm-config --patch '{"data": {"tenantOverrides.json": "{\"AureliaCorp\": {\"rateLimit\":30, \"fallback\": \"v1.11\"}}"}}'
```

ops-bot: Deploy triggered by mira (oncall) — rollout id r-2164507905

sam (customer-eng): pinging AureliaCorp CS/AM with short notice: "We're investigating degraded responses, will follow up with timeline and mitigation shortly."

mira (oncall): mitigation applied. observed error rate drop: 12% -> 1.2% over 6m. keeping watch, will hold until stable for 30m before declaring resolved

jen (sre): digging into root signals: per-tenant KV cache eviction thrash on nodes with high NVMe iowait. eviction spikes correlate with p99 latency jumps. collecting iostat + dstat for affected hosts

kai (eng-platform): seeing iowait spikes on nodes elm-node-7 and elm-node-9. looks like background backup job and eviction IO overlap. proposing cordon+drain 2 nodes and move pods to healthier nodes

alex (eng-runtime): secondary mitigation: clear AureliaCorp KV cache to stop eviction cascade and bump local TTL to reduce churn

mira (oncall): executing cache clear script now:
```
./tools/kvcache-clear --tenant AureliaCorp --pool elm-pool --confirm
```

ops-bot: Job kvclear-2164507940 started

ops-bot: Job kvclear-2164507940 completed (success)

mira (oncall): confirmation: after cache clear and rate limit the error rate is down to 0.8%, p95 latency normalized. continuing to monitor for 30m

jen (sre): started node remediation: cordon elm-node-7, cordon elm-node-9, drain scheduled pod moves. will apply IO-scheduling tweak to avoid backup overlap with peak traffic

kai (eng-platform): PR for IO-aware placement and backup scheduling alignment: https://git.redwood/eng-platform/pull/832 — staging deploy target: tomorrow 09:00 UTC

mira (oncall): mitigation milestone: traffic diverted, cache cleared, nodes being remediated. marking incident as mitigated once stable for window

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: alert-2164507890 mitigation in progress (mitigationId: mit-2164507960)

sam (customer-eng): draft customer note (short):
"Hi Aurelia team — We're investigating degraded responses that started ~11:12 UTC. We have applied a per-tenant rate limit, diverted traffic to a fallback model variant, and cleared your tenant's cache. Error rates are dropping and we're monitoring. We'll send a full RCA and proposed credit estimate shortly. Apologies for the interruption. — Sam, Redwood Customer Success"

mira (oncall): recovery observed at 2164508800 (error rate 0.4%). recording timeline and preparing for post-incident follow-up

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: alert-2164507890 resolved at 2164508800

sam (customer-eng): preparing post-incident comms and exec update. Proposed content: 1) incident timeline (start, mitigation actions, resolution), 2) root cause: KV cache eviction thrash due to NVMe IO contention during backup window, 3) short term mitigations taken, 4) planned long-term fixes, 5) proposed credit offer and next steps

alex (eng-runtime): long-term fixes to propose in RCA: a) per-node IO backpressure + KV TTL tuning, b) IO-aware placement (avoid scheduling backups during peak), c) telemetry for eviction rates and eviction-induced latency, d) fallback-model routing improvements for tenant isolation

jen (sre): RCA artifacts to include: graphs for eviction rates, p99/p95 serving latency, node iowait, correlation with backup jobs, and config diffs for the pool change. I'll assemble logs and timelines

mira (oncall): customer comm draft for approvals (please review):
"Hi AureliaCorp execs — Our team investigated and found your tenant experienced degraded requests between 11:12–11:52 UTC due to KV cache eviction cascades triggered by NVMe IO contention on two nodes. Immediate actions: applied a per-tenant rate limit, diverted traffic to fallback model variant v1.11, cleared tenant KV cache, and drained the affected nodes to reduce IO pressure. Recovery was confirmed at 11:53 UTC. Proposed next steps: platform fixes (IO-aware placement, KV TTL adjustments), and a proposed service credit estimate (subject to finance review). We will follow up with a detailed RCA and timelines by EOD. Apologies for the disruption. — Mira, Oncall"

sam (customer-eng): edit: change "service credit estimate" wording to "proposed credit estimate; final amount subject to finance review". also suggest we cc AM and legal for wording

jen (sre): rough credit calc for conversation: 30% of dedicated compute cost for 40-minute impact window. internal estimate (pre-finance): ~$4,800. flagging for finance to confirm official amount

kai (eng-platform): ETA for platform fix rollout to prod: 2 weeks after staging validations. will include a config knob for backup windows and IO scheduling

mira (oncall): assigning postmortem owners: jen (RCA lead), alex (runtime mitigation & docs), kai (platform fix), sam (customer comm & exec liaison)

ellie (security): quick check: no indication of data exfiltration; scope appears operational. will include note in final postmortem for compliance

sam (customer-eng): scheduling 1:1 with AureliaCorp for 15:00 UTC to present timeline and next steps. will mark the customer note as "proposed" until finance confirms credit amount

mira (oncall): handoff: I'm wrapping up but handing to night oncall ellie for shadow in case of recurrence. handoff checklist: runbook link, kvcache-clear cmd, rate-limit patch snippet, node cordon/drain steps

ellie (security): acknowledged. I have the runbook and the mitigation commands. will monitor overnight

mira (oncall): closing thread in incidents channel. final internal timestamps for RCA: incident_start 2164507920, mitigation_applied 2164508260, resolved 2164508800. please update the internal incident tracker and billing to start credit review

alex (eng-runtime): opening billing ticket NOW and tagging finance@redwood — ticket: BILL-2164508980

ops-bot: incident-thread archived to incidents/2164507890-thread
